name_input: AJIT INDUSTRIES PVT. LTD.; Ajit Industries Private Limited; AJIT INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED; AJIT IND.P.LTD.; AJIT INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED; Ajit Industries Private Limited; AJIT INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED; AJIT INDUSTRIES PVT LTD; AJIT INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED; Ajit Industries Private Limited; Ajit Industries Private Limited
product_summary: Per the company's own website (ajitindustries.com, homepage, accessed for this review): 'manufacturing and marketing of various types of Pressure Sensitive Self Adhesive Industrial tapes and Die-Cuts', incorporated 1998, brands 'AIPL SUNSUI', 'AIPL SUPER GOLD', 'EZ WONDER', 'EZ PACK'. Listed product categories on the site: Seam Sealing Tape, Sticky Mat, PROTEC+ PPF (paint protection film), Cork Tape, Dimple Tape, Reflective Tape, Acrylic Foam Tape, D/S Polyester Tape, Insect Repellent Tape, BOPP Tape, Cross Filament Tape, D/S Tissue Tape, Duct Tape, Floor Marking Tape, Foam Tape, HDPE Tape, Security Packing Tape, plus tape dispensers (manual/automatic) and a stationery and eco-friendly range. Served industries: automotive, white goods, wireharness, electrical, health & fitness, footwear, HVAC, insect repellent, label, packaging, paper mills, signage, surface protection. Core goods are plastic-film / foam / cloth self-adhesive tapes in rolls (HS 3919), plastic film sheets (3920/3921), plus dispensers (HS 8205/8479-type hardware) and stationery items.
comment: HS 4811.41 ('self-adhesive paper and paperboard, in rolls of a width not exceeding 15 cm') is only a marginal fit. The company's declared core business is pressure-sensitive adhesive tapes whose carrier is predominantly plastic film (BOPP, polyester/PET, PVC, HDPE, acrylic foam), fabric/filament, or foam — those fall in HS 3919.10/3919.90 (self-adhesive plates, sheets, film, foil, tape, strip in rolls, of plastics) and 3920.62/3921.12/3921.19 for non-adhesive or foam film. 4811.41 would apply only to the paper-based subset (e.g. paper masking/paper-tissue D/S tape, if offered), which is not evidenced as the main line. Verdict per project rule 3: company is NOT rejected — kept in the base, code corrected to the actual plastic-tape heading (3919.10 as primary), with 4811.41 retained only as a secondary line for paper-carrier tapes. Industry classification 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is a misclassification: the site positions the company as an industrial/B2B converter for automotive, white goods, wireharness, electrical, HVAC, label, packaging, paper mills and signage — construction/DIY is at most a minor adjacent channel (floor marking, surface protection). Trader signs: none found — the site describes own manufacturing ('manufacturing and marketing', ISO 9001/14001/45001 and IATF 16949 certified, own brands), so role = manufacturer; however no independent corroboration of plant capacity was checked in this pass. Product lines missing from the declaration: tape dispensers (manual and automatic), stationery range, eco-friendly range, paint protection film (PROTEC+ PPF), sticky mats, insect repellent tape, cork tape, reflective tape, dimple tape, cross filament tape, duct tape, foam/acrylic foam tape, seam sealing tape — none of these are covered by a single 4811.41 line. All product claims above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — sourced only from the company's own website; no customs line or shipment record was examined in this HS-only pass, and no revenue/volume/registry data was researched by design. Note: sub-pages (/products, /about-us, /contact-us, category pages) returned HTTP 404 at review time, so the catalogue could not be read item-by-item; the mapping rests on the homepage category list only.
